# apple_subscription_promotional_offer (Resource)

Manages a promotional offer on an auto-renewable subscription: a discount the app presents to a customer who has, or had, the subscription.

The App Store never shows a promotional offer on its own. The app asks for it at purchase time by `offer_code`, together with a signature its server computes with an In-App Purchase key, so `offer_code` is the value the app's code and this resource have to agree on. Who is eligible is the app's decision, not Apple's.

Apple's update request carries the prices and nothing else, so every other attribute is fixed at creation and changing one replaces the offer. The `prices` set changes in place.

~> **The subscription has to be available in every territory the offer is priced in.** An offer price references the subscription's own price point catalogue and territories, so an `apple_subscription_availability` covering them has to exist first. Nothing in the offer references it, so declare the ordering with `depends_on`.

~> **Treat an offer code as spent once used.** It is the offer's identifier, so expect Apple to refuse one already used on the subscription; Apple's API documents neither that rule nor whether deleting an offer ever releases its code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

data "apple_subscription_groups" "premium" {
  app_id = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
}

data "apple_subscriptions" "pro_monthly" {
  group_id           = data.apple_subscription_groups.premium.subscription_groups[0].id
  product_id_pattern = "^com\\.example\\.app\\.pro\\.monthly$"
}

locals {
  pro_monthly_id = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_monthly.subscriptions[0].id
}

# The offer price: what 4.99 in the United States is, and what that is worth
# in every other storefront the subscription sells in. The territories have to
# be ones the subscription's apple_subscription_availability covers.
data "apple_subscription_price_points" "offer_base" {
  subscription_id = local.pro_monthly_id
  territories     = ["USA"]
  customer_price  = "4.99"
}

data "apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations" "offer" {
  price_point_id = data.apple_subscription_price_points.offer_base.price_points[0].id
  territories    = ["GBR", "AUS"]
}

locals {
  offer_price_points = merge(
    { USA = data.apple_subscription_price_points.offer_base.price_points[0].id },
    data.apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations.offer.price_point_ids,
  )
}

# Half price for three months, for lapsed monthly subscribers. The app asks the
# App Store for it by offer_code, with a signature its server computes; who is
# eligible is the app's decision. Everything but prices is fixed at creation.
resource "apple_subscription_promotional_offer" "win_back" {
  subscription_id               = local.pro_monthly_id
  name                          = "Win back - half price"
  offer_code                    = "winback_half_3m"
  duration                      = "ONE_MONTH"
  offer_mode                    = "PAY_AS_YOU_GO"
  number_of_periods             = 3
  target_subscription_plan_type = "MONTHLY"

  prices = [
    for territory, price_point in local.offer_price_points : {
      territory_id   = territory
      price_point_id = price_point
    }
  ]
}

# A free trial names its territories and no price point.
resource "apple_subscription_promotional_offer" "free_month" {
  subscription_id   = local.pro_monthly_id
  name              = "Free month"
  offer_code        = "free_month"
  duration          = "ONE_MONTH"
  offer_mode        = "FREE_TRIAL"
  number_of_periods = 1

  prices = [
    for territory in ["USA", "GBR", "AUS"] : { territory_id = territory }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) The length of one offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS` or `ONE_YEAR`. With `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` it is the billing period being discounted; with `PAY_UP_FRONT` and `FREE_TRIAL` it is the whole offer. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `name` (String) The offer's reference name, internal to App Store Connect. Customers never see it. Cannot be changed after creation — Apple's update request has no `name` member.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) How many `duration` periods the offer lasts. For `PAY_UP_FRONT` and `FREE_TRIAL` this is normally `1`. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `offer_code` (String) The identifier the app passes to the App Store to request this offer, and that its server signs. Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. Expect Apple to refuse a code already used on the subscription; whether deleting the offer releases it is undocumented, so treat a code as spent once used. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `offer_mode` (String) How the customer pays during the offer: `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price each period), `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for the whole offer) or `FREE_TRIAL` (nothing). Cannot be changed after creation.
- `prices` (Attributes Set) The offer's price in each territory it is available in, one entry per territory. A set, because Apple returns them in no particular order. At least one is required — Apple requires the prices on every create, a free trial included. Changes in place: every write replaces the whole set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))
- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_subscription` this offer discounts. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) Which of the subscription's plans the offer applies to: `MONTHLY` or `UPFRONT`, matching `plan_type` on the subscription's prices. Optional; when it is left unset, whatever Apple reports is kept. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the promotional offer.

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Required:

- `territory_id` (String) The three-letter Apple territory code this price applies to, for example `USA`, `GBR` or `EGY`.

Optional:

- `price_point_id` (String) The ID of the subscription price point the customer pays during the offer, from `apple_subscription_price_points` or `apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations` for the same subscription. Required unless `offer_mode` is `FREE_TRIAL`, where a territory carries no price and this is omitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# By Apple's offer ID. The subscription is read back from the offer.
terraform import apple_subscription_promotional_offer.win_back 6741234567

# Or by "<subscription_id>/<offer_code>", the form an offer made in App Store
# Connect is known by: the offer code is what the app already holds.
terraform import apple_subscription_promotional_offer.win_back 6740021496/winback_half_3m
```
